sections.description:
BALOCHISTAN DIRECTORATE OF CULTURE AND TOURISM (BPS-16 AND ABOVE)
SERVICE RULES, 2009
BALOCHISTAN DIRECTORATE OF CULTURE AND TOURISM (BPS-16 AND ABOVE) SERVICE
RULES, 2009
(Amendments)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 20th December, 2010]
No.SOR-II(12)2/S&GAD/12366-415,
dated 20-12-2010.---In exercise of the powers conferred by section 25 of the
Balochisan Civil Servants Act, 1974 (Act No.IX of 1974), the Government of
Balochisan is pleased to make the following amendments in the Balochistan
Directorate of Culture and Tourism (BPS-16 and above) Service Rules, 2009,
namely:--
In the aforesaid rules,--
1. in the
reference clause for the words "the Directorate of Culture and Tourism
Balochistan" the words "the Directorate of Tourism Balochistan"
shall be substituted;
2. in rule
1, in sub-rule (1) for the words the "Directorate of Culture and Tourism
Balochistan" the words the "Directorate of Tourism Balochistan"
shall be substituted;
3. in the
appendix, for S.No.3 the following shall be substituted:-
3.
Assistant Director (B-17).
-----
By promotion from
amongst the members of the Service holding the post of Tourist Information
Officer (B-16) and Superintendent (B-16) having at least 3 years service as
such, on seniority cum fitness basis.
